Ricky Sandler increased its stake in Equifax Inc (EFX) by 74.42% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Eminence Capital Lp bought 752,408 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.76% with the market. The hedge fund run by Ricky Sandler held 1.76M shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $207.94 million, up from 1.01 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Eminence Capital Lp who had been investing in Equifax Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $13.86 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.48% or $0.55 $115.21. About 360,176 shares traded. Equifax Inc. (NYSE:EFX) has declined 14.11% since May 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 25.66% the S&P500.
